notes.title: English version update Sale
notes.notes:
‘Time of the Moons’ English version has been updated.

It was inspected by an English professor to reduce awkward expressions as many as possible.
I've made a lot of effort to avoid weird translations.

However, there still can be some mistakes I've missed because the main story is 175 pages and the NPC dialogue is about 100 pages.
There are too many hidden events in my game and I assume that there are more things that I missed.

If you see Korean or strange translation please send an e-mail.(dawnfox06@gmail.com). I will fix it with a laugh.

The sale will be starting on Aug 6, at 10:00 am.

I want you to have a wonderful adventure time in 'Time of the moon'. 
Thank you!

notes.title: About Update English version
notes.notes:
I am happy to tell you the good news.

‘Time of the Moon’s English version will be added soon.

It will be updated in the first week of August and at the latest in the second week.
I thank the people who waited!

Thank you.
